senses.gloss:
कैतट son of Jaiyaṭa, pupil of Maheśvara:
 Mahābhāṣyapradīpa. He quotes the Vākyapa-
dīya of Bhartṛhari, Harisetu and Kāśikāvṛtti,
[]
and is quoted in the Sarvadarśanasaṃgraha
Oxf. 247^a, the Mādhavīyadhātuvṛtti, by Viṭṭhala
Oxf. 161^b, by Puruṣottama Oxf. 161^a, by
Mallinātha Oxf. 113^a, by Śrīnivāsa Dīkṣita
Burnell 42^a, and others.
 Pravartakīya gr. Oppert 4222. II, 7644.
